title: Room and Well
author: Mara Underhill
blurb: Jonah Ishikawa, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
